title: stateRegistries
responsibility: Reads catalog and preview declarations as TypeScript syntax and required-state inventories as JSON without importing executable fixture modules.

inputs.name: stateRegistries.tree
inputs.description: A SourceTree whose list() supplies candidate paths and whose read(path) supplies their text. Only required-states JSON files and matching test/e2e support catalog, preview, scenario, or variant TS/JS files are read from the tree.

inputs.name: stateRegistries.root
inputs.description: Filesystem root passed to resolve(root, path) for extra paths absent from tree.list(); it matters only when such paths are requested. resolve keeps an absolute extra path absolute.

inputs.name: stateRegistries.extra
inputs.description: Additional file paths are read from disk only when their path is not already listed by the tree; relative paths resolve from root. A .json suffix selects JSON parsing and every other suffix selects TypeScript parsing; rows need a valid entity ID and TypeScript states need literal string arrays.

outputs.name: stateRegistries
outputs.description: Resolves to rows shaped as {entity, where, kind, states} extracted from matching JSON and TS/JS declarations, with where recording the path and kind set to required-states for matching paths or catalog otherwise. Entities outside the dotted/hyphenated ID pattern are ignored; state strings are deduplicated and empty strings become default.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The implementation calls fail() with "Cannot read required-state file <path>." when an extra file is unreadable, or "Cannot read required-state JSON <where>." when a selected .json file is invalid.

errors.name: Dependency failure
errors.description: tree.list() and tree.read() rejections propagate to the caller. Read failures for extra paths are caught and routed through the required-state-file fail() diagnostic.
